branching_wrong_type: branching is only allowed on single_choice and boolean fields
branching_bad_keys: branching keys must be valid answers, got: {bad}
option_too_long: options must be at most {max_length} characters, got one of {length}
right_answer_single: right_answer must be one of options for single_choice
right_answer_multi_empty: right_answer must list at least one option for multi_choice
right_answer_multi_values: right_answer values must all be in options for multi_choice
right_answer_boolean: right_answer for boolean must be 'true' or 'false'
fields_need_sections: all fields must have a section_id when sections are defined
sections_not_defined: section_id on fields requires sections to be defined
exam_needs_gradable: exam forms must contain at least one auto-gradable field
has_responses: This form has responses, so it can't be deleted. Archive it instead.
creator_only: Only the form creator can modify it
must_be_inactive: Form must be inactive to be deleted
foreign_fields: Field ids do not belong to this form: {foreign}
view_denied: Not allowed to view this form
publish_denied: Not allowed to publish this form
nothing_to_publish: The draft has no changes to publish
duplicate_denied: Not allowed to duplicate this form
manage_denied: Not allowed to manage this form
public_link_unavailable: Public link is only available for questionnaires that accept customer submissions
type_locked: A published form can't change its type; duplicate it instead
modify_denied: Not allowed to modify this form
bad_compare_target: against must be a version number or "draft"
branching_questionnaires_only: Branching is only supported on questionnaires
branching_needs_sections: Branching requires the form to have sections
branching_backwards: Section {source} can only jump forward, not to section {target}
branching_outside_section: Branching questions must belong to a section
branching_one_per_section: Section {section} can only have one branching question
